Capstone develops educational content and digital learning products. The Software Engineer I helps design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications, including products in the PebbleGo Suite, while collaborating with cross-functional teams and learning from experienced engineers.
Publishing
Work & Life Balance
No H1B
Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack software features using React and AWS technologies with guidance from experienced engineers
Troubleshoot application and production issues, identify root causes, and contribute to effective technical solutions
Participate in code reviews and paired programming to improve code quality and strengthen technical skills
Apply software development best practices to build reliable, secure, and scalable applications
Use approved AI tools responsibly to support development, testing, and problem-solving
Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Design, and QA teams to develop solutions that support customer and product needs
Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
Communicate development progress, technical challenges, and potential risks while contributing ideas and solutions
Work closely with mentors and team members to build technical knowledge, incorporate feedback, and successfully deliver assigned work

Ability to understand SDLC and Agile processes
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Strong communication skills as well as sharing ideas and gracefully receiving feedback
Understanding the concepts of software quality, security, and reliability
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States

Benefits
Hybrid position based out of the Eden Prairie, MN office: work from the designated office a minimum of two days per week, with the flexibility to work remotely up to three days per week.
Opportunities for professional learning and development.
Mentorship from experienced engineers and team members.
